feeds.title: Mental Health Reform News
feeds.description: Initially named The Irish Mental Health Coalition, Mental Health Reform was founded in 2006. The coalition was focused on holding the Government accountable for its delivery of that policy. In line with this vision, they drive the progressive reform of mental health services and supports, through coordination and policy development, research and innovation, accountability and collective advocacy. Explore more through their blog about the latest news, media, resources, events, and more.

feeds.title: Mental Health Ireland Blog
feeds.description: At Mental Health Ireland, they seek to advance good mental health and wellness for all people and communities and to aid those who have actually experienced mental health difficulties in their recovery, giving concrete form to national policy goals. They have development officers spread out over the nation that connects with the network of mental health associations, volunteers, and community organizations, promoting mental health and aiding recovery in local neighborhoods. Browse through their blog about the latest news, services, programs, webinars, resources, and more.

feeds.title: Limerick Mental Health Association Blog
feeds.description: The Limerick Mental Health Association was founded in 2002 by a group of individuals who recognized the need for support and resources for those affected by mental health challenges in the local community. It continues to serve as a vital resource for individuals and families seeking support and guidance on their mental health journey. It provides a safe, non-judgmental space where you can talk to us without fear of prejudice in a supportive and relaxed environment. Check out their blog and learn more about services, classes, events, articles, testimonials, and more.

feeds.title: Mad in Ireland
feeds.description: Mad in Ireland's mission is to serve as a catalyst for fundamentally rethinking theory and practice in the field of mental health in Ireland and promoting positive change. They believe that the current diagnostically-based paradigm of care has comprehensively failed and that the future lies in non-medical alternatives that explicitly acknowledge the causal role of social and relational conflicts, abuses, adversities, and injustices. Check out their blog and learn more about the latest news, podcasts, articles, guidelines, services, and more.

feeds.title: Irish Tech News » Mental Health
feeds.description: Dive into their blog and learn more about the latest news, podcasts, articles, reviews, and more. Irish Tech News is an award-winning online publication aimed at keeping you informed of all the latest news from the world of Technology. With the main focus on Irish-based news, they cover a wide range of topics from social media and smartphones to start-ups and SMEs. They have assembled a talented team of writers, each expert in their own field, helping them to cover as diverse a range as possible without losing focus or quality.

feeds.title: Way Ahead Therapy Blog
feeds.description: Occupational Therapist Jen Trzeciak is the founder of Way Ahead Therapy. She has worked in mental health services in the UK and Ireland for over 20 years. They offer individual mental health support, both online and face-to-face, wherever and whenever suits you. Their clinical work is fully evidence-based and delivered by experienced mental health professionals. Go through their blog and learn more about their services, testimonials, latest news, articles, media, podcasts, and more.

feeds.title: Fettle Online Therapy Ireland Blog
feeds.description: Fettle, Ireland's leading online therapy platform. They were founded in 2021 against the backdrop of global lockdowns with the goal of providing quality mental health services and counseling in an accessible way. They are creating a platform that puts the power of great mental health in everyone's reach. They aim to revolutionize how Ireland accesses mental health support by delivering unparalleled, accessible, and expert counseling right to your doorstep. Get into their blog and learn more about their services, pricing, health care tips, and more.

feeds.title: CORE Ireland Blog
feeds.description: Core Ireland, is a community-driven organization that provides volunteer opportunities for people who want to give back to their community and experience the joy of helping others. They believe that the strength and power of their organization come from their members and volunteers. Their mission is to make a positive impact on the lives of the most vulnerable members of their society. Go through their blog and learn more about their services, courses, news, events, articles, and more.

feeds.title: Smart TMS Ireland Blog
feeds.description: Smart TMS was founded by Dr Leigh Neal, a consultant psychiatrist with over 20 years of experience. They are going to make new, safe treatment protocols available to patients who want to improve their lives. It offers rTMS for addiction and a range of other mental health conditions and was the first clinic in the UK to offer treatment for conditions other than depression. Visit their blog and learn more about their services, treatment, the latest news, testimonials, and more.
